purpose: Teach: 玲子/聖子/茜/秀雄/浅田/川端/吉本/細田

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの玲子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Reiko from the next class.
lines.style: Casual tease, light accusatory lilt. Watching his reaction. Quick pace, like she's caught him at something small and amusing. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお母様、聖子さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your mom's name is Seiko, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Deflection masked as innocence. Slightly rushed delivery — turning the tables before she can push. Softer than his usual cool. A small, genuine smile underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの茜と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you talking to Akane from the next class.
lines.style: Sharper this time, testing him. Same tease, same light trap. Watching to see if he'll keep deflecting or finally react. Slight smirk.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣の秀雄おじさんと挨拶してたな、桜
lines.en: So you were saying hello to your uncle Hideo next door, huh, Sakura?
lines.style: Flat, matter-of-fact deflection. No smile. Turning her observations back on her with cool precision. Protecting himself by making her the subject instead.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、図書館で浅田次郎の小説借りてたな
lines.en: Riku, I caught you checking out an Asada Jiro novel at the library.
lines.style: Softer, slightly impressed undertone breaking through the tease. Less accusatory now — more curious about what he was reading. Genuine interest showing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、国語で川端康成の伊豆の踊子読んだろ、桜
lines.en: You read 'The Izu Dancer' by Yasunari Kawabata in Japanese class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. Like he's noticed something about her taste that matters. Not defensive this time — actually interested. The cool facade dropped slightly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、吉本興業のYouTube観てたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you watching Yoshimoto Comedy videos on YouTube.
lines.style: Wry amusement, almost a laugh in the voice. This one's funny to her — less about catching him, more about him being predictable in a way she finds endearing. Warm mockery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、細田守監督の映画一気見してたろ、桜
lines.en: You were binge-watching Mamoru Hosoda films, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft, almost wondering. Like he's realised they like the same things. No defensiveness now — just genuine connection breaking through. Almost tender.
